rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and the provided 3AA label, but it overstates image-specific certainty (e.g., exact ICM position, polarization, hermetic TE seal, no multinucleation) and appears to rely partly on the lab grade rather than only visible features.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, BMI, endometrium, semen parameters, and first-cycle status with embryo quality to frame prognosis.
Overall structure is logical, but the probability section contains visible self-correction, inconsistent calculations, and some overconfident claims, reducing coherence.

Core recommendations such as eSET and standard luteal support are guideline-concordant, but several suggestions are weakly supported or premature (ERA after one failure, embryo glue promotion, acupuncture, thrombophilia/immunology workup), and implantation estimates are somewhat optimistic.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including eSET and follow-up options, though some recommendations are not ideally prioritized or evidence-based.
